requirement: The Tracy address of a published site with a connected own domain sends visitors and crawlers to that domain with a 301

oracle.ref: PR #1399 (fix); fix evidence: Measured 15/10/2026 on production: a published site with a connected own domain answered 200 at its Tracy address, also to a Googlebot user agent, with rel=canonical and robots.txt on the Tracy address. Parent commit of the fix: 200 for an anonymous GET in the router test; after the fix: 301 to the own domain.
oracle.invariant: S1: 301, Location https://<own domain> with the same path and query, cache-control no-store; the site is not asked (pre-fix: 200 with the site's page and a canonical pointing at the Tracy address). S2: each is proxied to the site as before (no 301); every Design system preview answer carries x-robots-tag noindex, nofollow; the read mark is not passed on to the CMS. S3: served at the Tracy address as before, no redirect.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
